server.name: locus-credits
server.title: Locus Pro API tools
server.description: Discover and run pay-per-use APIs against one governed Locus Pro credit balance.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Locus Pro: pay-per-use APIs billed to one credit balance.

For repeatable Workflows, load the registered locus-workflows-stage skill when available; otherwise call get_locus_guide. Call web_research for grounded answers, web_extract for exact URLs, router_web_search for sources, or commerce_search for products. Otherwise use search_apis(query), then execute(slug, args) with its returned schema. For enabled:false, call request_tool_access and send its approval_url to the human. describe_api(slug) refreshes contracts. Pass max_credits to cap a charge. Read balances with get_balance().

Calls are live and billed; charges appear in structuredContent and _meta. RETRIES: pass "idempotency_key" to execute (or _meta "locus/idempotencyKey" on any burn tool) — the same key never double-charges. Without one, retries deduplicate best-effort; intentional repeats need a fresh key. Replays carry idempotent_replay:true and no new charge. When an error returns approval_token and idempotency_key, call execute again with both unchanged. Use ?compact=1 for compact text.

AUTH: interactive clients use discovered OAuth and consent. Service credentials include tenant keys and scoped agent credentials; end-user credentials remain user-bound. Failures return isError:true with an actionable hint.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Locus Pro API tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Locus Pro API tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.stage.paywithlocus.com/api/credits/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Locus Pro API tools MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Locus Pro API tools scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Locus Pro API tools's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Locus Pro API tools scores 82/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 20 of 20 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Locus Pro API tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Locus Pro API tools in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: How can Locus Pro API tools improve its MCP documentation?
